profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity, origin, time) and estar (location, temporary state); hay for existence. Subject pronouns are usually dropped; the verb ending marks the person. Grammatical politeness: tú vs usted (ustedes is the only plural 'you' in Latin America). Negation with no before the verb, double negatives (no ... nada/nadie/nunca). Questions by intonation or question words with accents (qué, dónde, cuándo, cómo, cuánto, quién, por qué). Modals: poder, querer, tener que, deber; ir a + infinitive for the near future; gustar-type verbs with indirect object pronouns. Gender on nouns and adjectives; articles el/la/los/las, un/una. Closed sets: subject pronouns, question words, object pronouns, articles, days, months, numbers.
